# Schnirelmann — every number is a sum of boundedly many primes

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** planned: new, not yet proved · **Diagram:** [Gaps between survivors and between primes](../../GRAPH.md#gaps-between-survivors-and-between-primes)

There is a constant c such that every number at least 2 is a sum of at most c primes (Schnirelmann 1930). The input from sieves is the upper bound for Goldbach pairs; the rest is Schnirelmann density.
